Margin LMS Flutter Web release build
Built: 2026-11-05
API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000

This folder can be served directly for local use. For production, rebuild from
the project root with the real HTTPS backend origin:

flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://api.example.edu

Configure the web server to fall back to index.html for unknown routes.
